name: powersnexus
description: PowersNexus 工程技能库：TDD、系统化调试、头脑风暴、计划与执行、代码评审、子代理协作、UI/UX 等经过验证的工作流。

skills.description: Use for L2+ behavior or feature work after L0-L4 classification. Produces a design proportionate to task risk; L0/L1 lightweight changes bypass this skill.
当面临多个可选方案且各有利弊、需要基于置信度做结构化决策时使用。为候选方案分层评估并给出可追溯的决策依据。

Use when a powersnexus session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the powersnexus maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.
Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
为研究型、探索性工作设计的专用流程。当任务是调研、理解代码库、验证假设而非交付功能时使用。

Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work - guides completion of development work by presenting structured options for merge, PR, or cleanup
在设计、实现或修改面向用户的网页、移动端界面、页面布局、组件样式或设计系统时使用。将产品目标转化为可验证的视觉契约，并在实现前后完成响应式、交互状态、可访问性和视觉审阅，避免功能正确但审美粗糙的界面。
使用时机：用户说"grill me / 盘问一下 / 帮我理清需求"，或任务规模评估将小项目、个人项目、非编码工作（文档/PRD/数据分析/运营流程）路由到此技能时。用于把模糊想法、计划或设计拷问成无歧义、可验收的契约。
Manages artifact generation, delta specs, and change lifecycle for PowersNexus. Generates proposal, specs, design, and tasks documents in .novaway/powersnexus/changes/ directory.

Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
设计或实现完成后、合并前使用。派出安全、性能、边界条件等多个角度的并行审查子代理，专门寻找方案中的漏洞与风险。
Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
任务规模评估器，自动识别任务规模并推荐 L0-L4 五级流程
Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
在构建或重做网页、移动端界面、仪表盘、营销页、表单、导航、图表或设计系统时使用。基于本地 UI/UX Pro Max 设计知识库生成与检索视觉方向、色彩、排版、布局、交互、无障碍和框架实践；在实现前为 frontend-quality 提供可追溯的设计依据。
Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
Use when starting a coding session or choosing a workflow - classifies work by L0-L4 and activates only the smallest directly responsible skill set

Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
